raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-18, so 327 raw rows duplicate txn_ids already loaded at 02:00 (raw has 5154 rows but only 4827 distinct txn_ids). silver_transactions keeps every raw copy, which inflates the duplicate keys, the 2026-01-17 volume, and every gold aggregate built from silver. The fix is to keep one row per txn_id (the latest delivery) before the POSTED filter; the sampled duplicate pair is identical, but I have not verified that all re-delivered copies match.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
